== Summary ==
A game at the [[2007 Match Play Championship]] (20–21 January 2007). The poster's file name is "Hawbaker and Konsker - Baltimore vs": [[Erich Hawbaker]] (left, "HAWBAKER" jersey) and [[Jarad Konsker]] (right, white Yankees cap). Three background onlookers and adjacent players unlabeled.

== Source ==
Posted on the Players Committee forum by Aglets: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=193821#p193821 post 193821], "Pictures, Pictures, and more Pictures from the MPC" (topic 13762), 27 January 2007. Photobucket album MKole, image HawbakerandKonsker-Baltimorevs.jpg. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105005909/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t13762.html Internet Archive]
* '''Watermark:''' This copy carries the Groupsy/Photobucket watermark that Photobucket stamped on re-served images; no unwatermarked copy was found (the Photobucket album is no longer public).
